summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on finalizing a project plan, particularly regarding the integration of demographic data and improving conversion tracking functionality. 

**Key Points & Decisions:**
*   **Demographics:** It was decided that demographic data should be loaded using zip codes and then connected to the main dataset.
*   **Conversion Tracking:** The need for a functional dropdown list of points (locations) for viewing conversion metrics was highlighted, as this feature is currently missing from the interface. 
*   **Real-Time Functionality:** One participant noted that real-time functionality was not yet completed, while other elements were mostly finished.
*   **Data Visualization/UI:** The plan involves structuring the data first, followed by UI adjustments and widget development to ensure calculations are performed internally rather than being summarized externally.

Someone mentioned receiving frequent requests for updates from specific team members.
decisions: Demographic data will be loaded using zip codes and connected to existing data.
action_items: One participant will develop the demographic data integration (zip code loading).
The UI needs a functional dropdown list for viewing conversion metrics by location.
Adjustments are needed on the widget development to ensure internal calculation of summaries.
